diagnostics.message: The null-forgiving `!` silences the nullable warning without proving the value is non-null.
diagnostics.help: Handle the null case (guard, `??`, or throw with context) instead of asserting non-null. Use `!` only when non-null is provable, and say why.

scoreImpact.rationale: The null-forgiving ! silences nullable safety without proving the value is non-null.
